g3.interval: Joint stratified MLE delta intervals; development-frozen global error multiplier; exact random-X sign baseline
g3.sensitivity_unit: source log odds ratio, not generator coefficient

g4.method: Penalized saturated fusion with source independence shrinkage; selected using training/calibration only

g5.natural: Leave-panel-out predictive Dirichlet transfer shrinkage, hyperparameters trained on training-panel counts; original heldout roles retained
g5.reliability: Separate likelihood-ratio calibration from final simulator evaluation; original target and misspecification scenarios retained

exclusions: No effect-based data exclusions; both cancers, all scenarios and failures retained
evaluation_scope: New simulation streams; real patients previously explored, not external replication
stopping: One bounded development/evaluation cycle; no score-triggered optional sampling
figure: PDF SVG 600dpi six requested colors; actual reference review before drawing
